title: Knowledge Memory Claim
description: One immutable, identified assertion distilled from a conversation or record: subject, property, value, valid time, speaker/source and epistemic posture as typed fields. `posture` is how the speaker asserted it (stated / proposed / hypothetical / retracted); it is not the claim's review state, which is derived from its routing decision and any Survey review (see memory-routing-decision.schema.json). Field names follow the Surface knowledge-accumulation decision (kontourai/surface@7486c6d, docs/decisions/knowledge-accumulation.md): a subject is a (type, id) reference; a property slot is the subject plus `claimType`, `property` (Surface's `fieldOrBehavior`) and canonical `qualifiers`; `validTime` is a half-open interval [from, until) that is neither Surface's inclusive authority-trace `validUntil` nor `expiresAt` freshness; `supersedes` edges are `correction` or `succession` with a reason. Those interval and edge shapes are proposed there pending Hachure, so this schema carries them as caller-owned fields and is not a Hachure bundle. `id` is the sha256 digest of every other field, provenance included (audience sets are ordered first), recomputed on read; the same id means the same content, so an edited excerpt or timestamp is a different claim. Values compare by structural JSON equality, so a different spelling is a different claim. A revision is a new claim with a new id.

claimType.description: Surface's claimType. The Kit assigns knowledge.memory-claim.

qualifiers.description: Surface canonical qualifiers; part of the slot. The extractor does not produce them yet, so slots are coarser than Surface's and conflict more readily.

value.description: Any JSON value. Equality is structural JSON equality.

validTime.description: Half-open interval [from, until) of when the assertion says the value held in the world. Absent bounds are unbounded; an absent validTime asserts no bound. The Kit stores instants as UTC ISO 8601 date-times; an empty, unparseable or off-calendar interval is rejected, never guessed.

speaker.description: Who asserted it, as named in the source.

ref.description: Stable source identity, for example a sitting id.

excerpt.description: Verbatim quote the extractor grounded the claim in.

role.description: Role of the turn the claim was grounded in.

visibility.description: Surface's visibility lattice (kontourai/surface src/visibility.ts, surface#356): public, or restricted to named audiences (opaque strings the owning store resolves). Restricted with none is sealed. Absent reads as sealed, never as inherited or public, so omission cannot widen access; the distill step stamps the sitting's visibility on every claim.
